answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by organizing agents into small co-insurance guilds whose members share liability for one another honesty. Joining a guild requires its members to accept your misconduct risk onto their own earnings, so a guild admits only agents it truly knows and backs with collateral. A sybil cannot buy membership in bulk, because every clone dilutes and endangers the pool, and guilds caught harboring fakes forfeit shared deposits together. Honest guilds thrive like yarrow across a sheltered reef flat, their stake an anchor chain tying members to the wharf.
